meta_description:
7,945 likes, 453 comments - grantcardone on October 21, 2026: "Being invited to the White House as part of the SBA’s Million Dollar Pitch Competition to celebrate 250 years of American free enterprise alongside @sba_kelly, Joe Gebbia, Nicki Minaj, and @deuces1966 was an honor I will never forget.

Thank you to @realdonaldtrump for making the time to sit down with us. Thank you to the @sbagov. And thank you to every small business owner in this country who keeps building.".
